Present continuous be + V-ing · 混合演练: The present continuous expresses an action happening at this moment; Listen!/Look! often signal it.本课为混合演练练习,核心:am/is/are + V-ing indicates an action happening right now。

be + V-ing is indispensable|The -ing form of verbs ending in e drops the e: making|A single stressed closed syllable doubles the final consonant: running|The negative is be + not + V-ing|The question moves be before the subject
